advisories.summary: Pure-layer transitive effects are not yet recorded against a permitted graph. sha2 0.11.0 dispatches at runtime through cpufeatures 0.3.1: a constant true for sha2 on aarch64-apple, getauxval on aarch64 linux/android, CPUID on x86. cpufeatures has a target-conditioned libc 0.2.189 edge. libc's build script runs $RUSTC_WRAPPER/$RUSTC --version on every build and reads environment variables. No network or package manager; digest bytes do not depend on the dispatch; dependencies contain unsafe that forbid(unsafe_code) does not cover.
advisories.scope: M1 inventory/tooling successor (permitted-graph record, or a SHA-256 implementation without the libc edge)

advisories.summary: Public H minting accepts any lexical Value and any syntactically valid domain, and returns an untyped [u8;32]. Counterexample: digest::identity("snapshot", <parsed {"inventory":[{"path":"b"},{"path":"a"}]}>) returns an H for a descriptor that path-order admission would refuse. Documented as the caller's duty and inside this unit's scope.
advisories.scope: Future descriptors.rs/digests.rs: registered-domain H must consume admitted typed descriptors; Value must not become a carrier

advisories.summary: Refusal precedence differs from canonical.py, though both refuse. {"a":1,"a":1.5} gives DuplicateKey here and a float refusal in the reference; 33 nested arrays around 1.0 give DepthLimit here and a float refusal in the reference.
advisories.obligation: No D9 code mapping is claimed in this unit

advisories.summary: Memory amplification within the 4 MiB bound is unmeasured. Estimated Value size is 32 bytes, so [0,0,...] at 4 MiB grows a Vec<Value> toward roughly 64-128 MiB. All paths are linear. A counting-allocator probe is prepared but has not run.
Derived Clone/PartialEq/Debug/Drop recurse without a bound on caller-built Values nested deeper than 32. Parsed values are bounded, and encode stops at depth 33.
advisories.scope: Future carriers should not hold unbounded caller-built Values

advisories.summary: Oracle provenance and coverage gaps. The four H hex goldens have no retained provenance (H is still pinned by the literal frame plus FIPS SHA vectors). 21 malformed cases assert only is_err. Untested: UTF-8 key order across widths and prefixes, the full C0 escape table and escapes in keys, uppercase \u hex, duplicates via \/, frame lengths over 255, mixed depth, ByteLimit precedence. The Python verifier tests cover only the activation cross-link, not the review/assent/completion refusal branches.

Verifier looseness, all failing closed or digest-bound. Approval rows are not field-closed and bytes is optional. completion.remainingRequiredDesignFindings is not checked. A non-object approval document raises AttributeError outside main's catch set. The verifier proves membership in the accepted subject, not that a selected input is the current normative source.
advisories.scope: Developer tooling; which inputs are current belongs to plan review

advisories.summary: Validation capture m1-canonical-validation-01 ran in the product working tree, not the snapshot. It started with a mutating cargo fmt --all, records no source digests, omits the unittest (7) and verifier (46) runs, and keeps only the pre-fix source of the failing initial run. The corrected boundary is arithmetically right: 699050*6+2=4194302, 699051*6+2=4194308. Running the snapshot unittest without -B writes __pycache__ into the snapshot's tools/.
